hero.title: Physiotherapy in Italy – Complete Guide for International Students
hero.subtitle: Pursue a three-year, 180 ECTS Laurea in Fisioterapia in Italy combining theoretical study, laboratory training, and supervised clinical placements.

highlights.eligibility: Class 12 with Science + Entrance Exam + Italian Proficiency

overview: Physiotherapy in Italy is an option for students interested in rehabilitation, human movement, injury recovery and patient care. Italian universities provide under-graduate courses. These combine theoretical study, laboratory training and supervised clinical assignments. The regular degree, Laurea in Fisioterapia normally takes three years and is worth 180 ECTS credits.

Students planning to study physiotherapy in Italy should understand the course structure, teaching language, admission requirements, tuition fees and professional registration rules before applying. Most of the physiotherapy undergraduate courses are taught in Italian and have limited places available, so it is important to start preparing for the admission process early on.

Edu-hawk Worldwide helps students to find out the right universities, understand the eligibility criteria, prepare the documents for the application and organize the study abroad plans. Students are encouraged to seek out the latest details on program specifications and requirements for professional licensure from the university and regulatory organizations.

items: Choosing to Study Physiotherapy in Italy can give students access to a structured healthcare education system, practical clinical experience and an international university environment. Physiotherapy programs assist patients improve movement, manage physical limits, and restore function after an injury or sickness.
Key advantages include:
Clinical learning: Programs typically include supervised rotations in healthcare facilities. Students study anatomy, physiology, biomechanics, and rehabilitative principles.
Practical experience: Laboratory activities and clinical training assist students improve their evaluation and patient care skills.
European intellectual exposure: Students gain university education in Italy and can pursue international academic opportunities.
Some public colleges have relatively low tuition rates, depending on the institution and price type.

Graduates may pursue postgraduate courses and specialized training in rehabilitation, provided they satisfy the admission requirements. When selecting an institution, students need to look into the language of instruction, the availability of clinical placements, the total cost of the program and the requirements for professional registration.

Physiotherapy Courses in Italy generally lead to a three-year undergraduate degree in Physiotherapy, known in Italian as Laurea in Fisioterapia. The programme combines academic subjects, practical laboratory work and clinical placements.

Postgraduate and Specialised Study

Graduates with a qualifying undergraduate degree may choose to pursue further study in areas like sports rehabilitation, neurological rehabilitation, musculoskeletal care, rehabilitation sciences and research.
Admission requirements vary by program. Some of the more advanced courses require you to have a current physiotherapy qualification or professional registration.

sections.title: Physiotherapy Universities in Italy
sections.lead: When comparing Physiotherapy Universities in Italy, students should examine the course language, clinical training arrangements, admission process, tuition fees and location. The following institutions publish information about their physiotherapy programmes.

items: University of Bologna

The University of Bologna has a campus in Bologna and offers a three year degree in Physiotherapy. 81 places in the 2026/27 academic year are indicated on the official program information, in Italian language, with restrictions on admission at national level through a local examination process.
The program is based on academic study with practical training in health care facilities.
Official course page: https://www.unibo.it/en/study/first-and-single-cycle-degree/programme/2026/8476
University of Milan

The University of Milan has a three-year undergraduate degree in physiotherapy. According to the program material for 2026/27, the language of instruction is Italian and the degree is restricted-admission. The university issues the admission details including the selection process and the number of seats.
For the next intake deadlines, required documentation, and revised admission instructions, applicants should see the official website.
Official course page: https://www.unimi.it/en/education/bachelor/physiotherapy
University of Genoa

The University of Genoa has a 3 year Bachelor’s Degree in Physiotherapy worth 180 credits. Its 2026/27 program material lists Italian as the language of instruction and specifies an admission test. Tuition and fees at the university range from €0 to €3,000 per year, depending on the pricing situation.
Official course page: https://corsi.unige.it/en/corsi/9281
Other Italian Universities

Students may also look into physiotherapy programs at other public and private schools, including universities in Rome and Verona. Courses, teaching locations, entry requirements and costs may differ from one academic year to another.
The official portal of Universitaly is a useful starting point to study accredited higher education courses in Italy: https://www.universitaly.it/
Important: Do not assume that every physiotherapy degree in Italy is taught in English. Verify the language of the exact programme before applying.
Eligibility for Physiotherapy in Italy for Indian Students depends on the applicant’s educational qualifications, the university’s admission rules and the requirements for the relevant academic year.
Common needs can include:
Completion of secondary education is equivalent to the Italian university entrance criteria.
Class 12 or similar academic credentials.
Appropriate preparation in important scientific subjects.
Compliance with the university's admissions test and selection process.
Proficiency in Italian is required for programs taught in that language.
Submission of required identification and academic documents.
Meeting any other conditions set by the institution.
Requirements for Indian Applicants

Indian students should ensure that their Class 12 qualification is acknowledged by their preferred university. They may be required to present academic transcripts, translated documents, or qualification evaluation forms.

Because most typical undergraduate physiotherapy programs are taught in Italian, applicants should plan on developing adequate Italian language skills for lectures, exams, clinical placements, and patient communication.

Students should also establish whether the university requires an entrance exam, a certain ranking position, or any other selection criterion. Meeting the minimum academic standards does not guaranty acceptance into a limited-entry program.
Students planning to Study Physiotherapy in Italy should read the official admission notice for their intended intake. Requirements and deadlines may change from one academic year to another.
Frequently requested papers include:
Completed the university application form.
Valid passport.
Certificates and marksheets from classes 10 and 12.
Academic transcripts.
Proof of Italian language proficiency, if required.
Admission test registration and outcomes.
Documents for qualification assessment are available upon request.
Pre-enrollment documentation for qualified international candidates.
Additional forms required by the university.
Admission Test

In Italy physiotherapy is often a restricted entry healthcare degree. The universities will give you the details of the selection process, the examination, the vacancies and the dates of admission. For example, the University of Milan has announced that its admission test for the 2026/27 intake will be held on September 16, 2026. This date has already passed and applicants expecting a future intake should wait for the next formal admission notice from the university rather than relying on the calendar of the previous year.
Edu-Hawk Worldwide can help students compare universities, understand application steps and prepare document checklists. Final admission decisions remain with the institutions.

Physiotherapy Fees in Italy vary according to the university, student fee category, income-assessment rules and any available exemptions or scholarships. The cost of public colleges can be cheaper than some private schools, but you should figure out the exact amount using the official tuition schedule.
For example, the University of Genoa’s Physiotherapy program for 2026/27 has annual tuition and fees of €0-€3,000. The student is charged a fee based on the terms and conditions.

sections.title: Admission Process for Physiotherapy in Italy

items: The application process for Physiotherapy in Italy for Indian Students generally includes the following steps:
Look at universities: Compare physiotherapy programs, language of instruction, location and clinical experience.
Verify eligibility: Review the academic qualifications, language requirements and selection criteria.
Check the admission process: Find out if you need to take an entrance test or go through a ranking process.
Get the papers ready: Gather your passport, school certificates, transcripts and language proofs.
Send the application: Follow the university’s instructions and meet the relevant deadline.

Full selection criteria: Register for and take the required examination, if any and Follow pre-enrolment procedures: Follow the steps for international applicants on the university and official portals.
Organize your visa: Check with the appropriate Italian Consulate for current requirements.
Plan your arrival: Book accommodation, insurance, travel and complete your enrollment.

If you are an overseas student and need a study visa, the Universitaly official webpage contains information about the pre-enrolment requirements. Just being accepted or pre-enrolled by a university does not guaranty a visa.
Edu-Hawk Worldwide can assist students with university shortlisting, application planning and document preparation.
Physiotherapy is a regulated healthcare profession. Students should check the professional requirements of the country where they intend to practise before enrolling.
Working as a Physiotherapist in Italy

If you are an international student and need a study visa, the official Universitaly website gives information about the requirements for pre-enrollment. Acceptance or pre-enrollment at a university does not guaranty the issuance of a visa.
Returning to India After Physiotherapy in Italy

Indian students who wish to return to India should assess the current recognition and registration processes for international physiotherapy qualifications. Requirements may vary based on the student’s qualifications, institution, curriculum and applicable restrictions at the time of graduation.
Before registering, please confirm:
The actual degree conferred.
Clinical training and practical hours are covered.
Determine whether the qualification fits the requirements of the planned country of practice.
The registration process, as well as any exams or additional training that may be required.
The most recent guidance from the relevant professional or regulatory authorities.
An international degree should not be taken to imply automatic eligibility to practise in India or any other country.

sections.title: Career Opportunities After Physiotherapy in Italy

items: Graduates who have completed a recognized qualification and met the necessary professional standards may pursue a variety of rehabilitation and healthcare careers.
Potential job paths include:
Hospital physiotherapy
Rehabilitation centres
Private physiotherapy clinics
Musculoskeletal rehabilitation
Sports rehabilitation
Neurological rehabilitation
Geriatric and elderly care
Paediatric rehabilitation
Community healthcare
Research and further education
Career options depend on professional recognition, language skills, practical experience, work authorization and company criteria. May need further training for specialized tasks.
Having a degree in physiotherapy does not guaranty you will have a job, a salary or the right to work in Italy or other countries.
Applicants considering Physiotherapy in Italy should prepare the documents requested by their chosen university. Common documents may include:
Valid passport.
Class 10 marksheet and certificate.
Class 12 certificate and marksheet.
Academic transcripts and credentials in support of it.
Proof of Italian language proficiency (if applicable)
Entrance Exam Registration or Results.
University application and enrollment forms.
Qualification evaluation documents are available by request.
Confirmation of pre-enrolment (where applicable).
The required visa, financial, insurance documentation required by the necessary authorities.

Some papers may require official translation, legalization, or apostille. The specific requirements vary depending on the university and the authority requesting the documents, so applicants should consult the most recent checklist before submitting anything.

faq.question: How long does Physiotherapy in Italy take?
faq.answer: The regular undergraduate physiotherapy degree typically lasts three years and awards 180 ECTS credits. It combines academic studies with supervised practical and clinical experience.

faq.question: Can Indian students study physiotherapy in Italy?
faq.answer: Yes, Indian students can pursue qualified programs if they meet the university's academic, language, and admission standards. They should also check the professional recognition standards if they plan to practice in India following graduation.

faq.question: Are Physiotherapy Courses in Italy taught in English?
faq.answer: Most undergraduate physiotherapy programs are taught in Italian. Students should check the language of the individual program and prepare for any needed Italian-language assessments.

faq.question: What are the Physiotherapy Fees in Italy?
faq.answer: Tuition varies according to university and student fee type. For example, the University of Genoa advertises annual costs ranging from €0-€3,000 for its 2026/27 program. Applicants should confirm the actual fee and allocate separate funds for living expenses.

faq.question: Is an entrance exam required for physiotherapy in Italy?
faq.answer: Many physiotherapy programs have limited enrollment and require a selection exam or other entrance procedure. The specific process, exam date, and number of seats vary depending on the university and academic year.
